intent.proves: No active website lacks a default shop, Ecommerce language or currency.
intent.scope: active, non-deleted websites; complete enumeration; at least one subject must be in scope

bindings.reason: Needs a field-level offender handler over get_areas rows; not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(AreaId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(AreaName, N'') FROM Area WHERE AreaActive = 1 AND AreaDeleted = 0 AND (ISNULL(AreaEcomShopId, N'') = N'' OR ISNULL(AreaEcomLanguageId, N'') = N'' OR ISNULL(AreaEcomCurrencyId, N'') = N'')
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Area WHERE AreaActive = 1 AND AreaDeleted = 0
